# datachart

> Data visualization package, simple to use, highly customizable

datachart is a Python data visualization package built on matplotlib.
It provides simple chart functions (BarChart, LineChart, ScatterChart,
Histogram, Heatmap, BoxPlot, ParallelCoords, PyramidChart,
RadialChart), figure
composition via Panel (overlaying charts on shared axes) and Grid
(arranging charts in a grid), and a global configuration system with
predefined themes.

Install with `pip install datachart`. All charts return a matplotlib
Figure. Style is controlled globally via `datachart.config.config` and
themes; per-chart overrides go in each chart's `style` parameter.


## Getting Started

- [Home](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/index.md): Package overview, installation, and a first example.
- [How-to Guides](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/index.md): Map of the guide sections: charts, composition & utilities, styling.

## Charts

- [Charts](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/charts/index.md): The chart functions, their common data format, and how to save figures.
- [Bar Chart](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/charts/barchart/index.md): Bar chart input attributes, single and multiple datasets, customization, and saving.
- [Box Plot](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/charts/boxplot/index.md): Box plot input attributes and customization; multiple datasets require subplots.
- [Heatmap](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/charts/heatmap/index.md): Heatmap input attributes, single and multiple datasets, customization, and saving.
- [Histogram](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/charts/histogram/index.md): Histogram input attributes, single and multiple datasets, and histogram views.
- [Line Chart](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/charts/linechart/index.md): Line chart input attributes, single and multiple datasets, customization, and saving.
- [Parallel Coordinates](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/charts/parallelcoords/index.md): Parallel coordinates input attributes and customization for multivariate data.
- [Pyramid Chart](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/charts/pyramidchart/index.md): Pyramid chart input attributes, the two-sides data contract, mirrored value axis controls, and composing pyramids with Grid.
- [Radial Chart](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/charts/radialchart/index.md): Radial chart input attributes, the line, bar, scatter, and histogram visuals, and polar settings (start angle, direction, inner radius).
- [Scatter Chart](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/charts/scatterchart/index.md): Scatter chart input attributes, single and multiple datasets, customization, and saving.

## Composition & Utilities

- [Composition & Utilities](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/utility/index.md): Map of Panel, Grid, statistics, and figure saving.
- [Panel](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/utility/panel/index.md): Overlaying multiple charts on one plot with Panel: dual y-axes, z-order, emphasis, and nesting panels.
- [Grid](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/utility/grid/index.md): Arranging multiple charts in a grid layout with Grid, including nested rows and layout specs.
- [Text Annotations](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/utility/annotations/index.md): Text annotations on any chart: placement and coordinates, connector looks, text and box styling, and annotating finished figures with Annotate.
- [Statistics](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/utility/stats/index.md): Statistical utilities for preparing chart data.

## Styling

- [Styling](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/styling/index.md): Map of configuration, themes, emphasis, and colormaps.
- [Config](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/styling/config/index.md): Customizing the global style via the config singleton: set_theme, update_config, reset_config.
- [Themes](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/styling/themes/index.md): Applying the predefined themes and creating custom ones.
- [Theme Gallery](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/styling/theme-gallery/index.md): Every predefined theme rendered across the chart types.
- [Highlighting](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/styling/highlighting/index.md): Emphasizing and muting data series with the emphasis option.
- [Colormaps](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/how-to-guides/styling/colormaps/index.md): The colormaps available via the COLORS constant.

## API Reference

- [Datachart Module](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/references/index.md): Top-level module reference.
- [charts](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/references/charts/index.md): Chart function signatures and parameters.
- [Utils Module](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/references/utils/index.md): Panel, Grid, and save_figure signatures.
- [stats](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/references/utils/stats/index.md): Statistical function signatures.
- [config](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/references/config/index.md): The Config class and the global config instance.
- [themes](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/references/themes/index.md): The predefined theme dictionaries.
- [constants](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/references/constants/index.md): Enums and constants (THEME, FIG_SIZE, ORIENTATION, COLORS, ...).
- [typings](https://eriknovak.github.io/datachart/0.8.0/references/typings/index.md): TypedDict definitions for chart data and style attributes.
